question: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International airport is situated in _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __Kolkata.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International Airport is located in Kolkata.__
 
• Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose airport is one of the oldest airports in India.
 
• Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport which was earlier known as "Dum Dum Airport" is situated in Kolkata.
 
• It was opened in 1924 AD and it is the fifth-busiest airport in India.​​
